content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the defendant was ordered to pay €11120 in professional fees the court resolved a matrimonial property case by granting the applicant a 111th share of a nonresidential premises and a car park the defendant was also ordered to provide a vehicle to the applicant however the court determined that the applicant should compensate the defendant with €5600 due to a greater share of the property the legal text discusses the concept of shares in matrimonial property establishment of an asset balance and shareable property the applicant sought dissolution of the marriage retention of their surname establishment of residence for their minor daughter and maintenance payment from the defendant the court will decide on the division of property including vehicles and the amount of maintenance to be paid the court dissolved the marriage awarded the applicant a share of the nonresidential premises and a car park and ordered compensation from the defendant the defendant is also responsible for the costs of the proceedings
